Carve's strike is 20% weapon damage (AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp:166-175) and the weapon roll includes the normalized attack power term, so a hit is about 890 points in the control arm and 1023 with the passive (measured hit sizes of the counted pair): each of the two integer truncations of SpellEffects.cpp:4743 and Unit.cpp:11670 loses under 1 point, so under 0.12% of a hit each and under 0.25% together, inside the band of 2 points; at ~30-point hits the same truncations cost about 3 points of the 15 (the first proves read +11.1% and +12.3% from that truncation, not from the server). $s1 = 15 (300466 Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectBasePoints 14 + EffectDieSides 1, MiscValue 0 = SPELLMOD_DAMAGE; Spell.dbc read with apps/coa-dbc/inspect_dbc.py), class mask 0x80 of family 20 widened by AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp:29-33 to 0x80/0/0x200000. Carve's strike 803715 (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 0x80, weapon percent damage) is cast at the dummy trials times without the passive (control) and with it learned by a real learn (treatment), non-critical hits only; mean damage per hit must rise by 15 percent (band 13..17, G-19). The control arm is the same cast without 300466. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 300466: 0 events in 186 logs (passive, never logged); coa-history spell 803715 (Carve hit): SPELL_DAMAGE 1086 events in 5 logs, 188 crits, min 37 max 1630 mean 307 (gear and channel length differ, no figure decides); bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22): Unholy Endurance 300466, Tyrant specialization, 'Increases the damage and threat generated from Carve by 15%.', same figure as the tooltip; nothing else found.

behaviours.name: Burning Hatred (Chaos copy is 50% of the swing damage)
behaviours.quote: causing your melee damage to leech health to you equal to $s1% of the damage dealt as Chaos damage
behaviours.observe_source: The Chaos damage of 807347 on the dummy over the caster's swing damage. 805239 Effect[0] aura 354, BasePoints 49 + 1 = 50 ($s1), DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms ($d). The event script (AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp: Check case 805239 returns melee, Proc case 805239 calls Copy(player, target, 807347, damage * 50 / 100), :243-244) casts 807347 with that amount as BasePoint0 (AscensionFelsworn.cpp:158-163). 807347 is SPELL_EFFECT_HEALTH_LEECH with EffectValueMultiplier 1.0, school mask 127 (Chaos), NO_ACTIVE_DEFENSE, NO_ATTACK_MISS, CANT_CRIT, IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS and IGNORE_DAMAGE_TAKEN_MODIFIERS, and as a Felsworn copy it ignores armor (AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp:61-67) and never procs the script again (Derived). The caster auto-attacks the dummy for 5 swing intervals (14000 ms) before and after a real cast of 805239; the after phase starts its attack 500 ms after the cast and stops it 14500 ms after it, inside the 15000 ms aura, so every swing the ratio divides by ran under Burning Hatred. Misses, dodges and parries add nothing to either side: the harness adds a swing to melee_damage_total only with damage (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:1778-1783, the SMSG_ATTACKERSTATEUPDATE damage, the sum of both sub-damages after absorb and resist, Unit.cpp:7800-7829) and the script copies only a damaging hit (Check: !damage returns false). the ratio divides the increase of the read over the after phase by the increase of the caster's own swing damage (melee_damage_total, both hands). The before arm reads 0 (no Burning Hatred, so no copy). Expected 0.5 from $s1; tolerance 0.02 (0.48 to 0.52) excludes 45%, 55%, a full copy (1.0) and no copy (0), and holds the integer division (at most half a point per odd swing). Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spells 805239 and 807347: 0 events in 186 logs; nothing found beyond the tooltip and Spell.dbc.

behaviours.name: Fel Torpedo (damage per hit)
behaviours.quote: Torpedo forward in the direction you're running and deal ${$500761m1+$500761ppl1+$AP*.35} Shadowflame Damage to enemies in your path.
behaviours.observe_source: Fel Torpedo 500610 (the Tyrant replacement 520853 of the Chaos Rush button) Effect[1] TRIGGER_SPELL 802028 (Chaos Rush Jump, CHARGE_DEST 10 yd ahead) and Effect[2] aura 23 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectAmplitude 250, EffectTriggerSpell 500761 (AttributesEx5 EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD, duration 500 ms); 500761 Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE on TARGET_SRC_CASTER / TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ENEMY, radius index 15 (3 yd), EffectBasePoints 74 + 1, EffectDieSides 5, EffectRealPointsPerLevel 4.6, BaseLevel 34, SchoolMask 36, EffectBonusMultiplier 0 (Spell.dbc, server set /srv/coa/server-data/dbc). Expected per hit at level 60, from the tooltip and the DBC: 194-198 (74 + int(26 x 4.6) + the die 1..5) + 0.35 x AP, the sum truncated once (SpellInfo.cpp CalcValue); the 0.35 x AP term comes from the FelswornCoefficients row of 500761 (Felsworn ADR 0009, mentor D-56). The hit judge reads the tooltip model and accepts a mean inside the engine model's 99% interval as known engine rounding (ADR 0147, ADR 0006 Addendum). Both arms hold aura 823764 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE -9999 on the magic schools) so the dummy's level-based partial resists do not land, and every trial first teleports the caster back to trial_position, 2 yd behind the dummy, because each cast dashes it 10 yd forward. The caster knows 520853 in both arms; the control arm makes no cast and must count 0 hits of 500761 on the dummy. Hits per cast on one dummy, measured on the pre-fix server (fw-t4, runs 20261123-185607 and 20261123-185756): 2 in every trial (the initial tick and one 250 ms tick before the dash leaves the 3 yd radius); the tooltip says 'deal ... to enemies in your path' and states no hit count, and the 500762 Debuff Dummy that 500761 Effect[2] applies has no server handler. Owner ruling Felsworn O-25 (2026-11-23) (Felsworn ADR 0013): one hit per enemy per caster per cast, so 6 hits over the 6 trials after the fix; the hit count is judged by the caster_hits entries torpedo_once, torpedo_once_far and torpedo_two_casters. Before the fix (same runs): 196.17 per hit at AP 312 and 196.42 at AP 1312, flat in AP. Reference search 2026-11-23: render 3 report: Fel Torpedo shown 304 at AP 312 = 194.6 + 109.20; bindmysoul talents snapshot: 'deal 195 + 35% AP Shadowflame Damage'; 500761 and 500762 helper texts carry the same $AP*.35; coa-history spell 500761: 0 events in 186 logs, spell 500610: 6 casts in 1 log, no damage line; nothing else found.

Owner ruling Felsworn O-25 (2026-11-23) (Felsworn ADR 0013): each enemy is damaged once per caster per cast; AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp drops from a 500761 cast every enemy that this caster's current 500610 cast already hit (the list is cleared at each 500610 cast and keyed by the caster), so a second caster's Torpedo is not blocked. This entry: one caster, dummy 2 yd ahead, where the stock engine hit twice (ticks 1 and 2); each trial must add exactly 1 hit (the control is the cumulative read: 0 before the first cast, then one more per cast; the pre-fix server reads 2 more per cast).

behaviours.name: Legionfall (the cost reduction lasts $801902d)
behaviours.quote: within $801902d
behaviours.observe_source: Expected 15000 ms: Spell.dbc 801902 DurationIndex 8, SpellDuration.dbc row 8 Duration 15000 (the $801902d of the tooltip). 801902 is cast on the caster by the Legionfall handler (AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp:201-203) after a landed melee ability hit rolled Chance() on the raw ProcChance 15 (AscensionFelsworn.cpp:231-239), which no spell modifier forces, so the aura is earned for real: the cast_until_aura step (owner-approved) casts Annihilan Strike every 1700 ms until 801902 is on the caster, at most 47 casts (one roll per cast at 15% leaves 0.85^47 = 0.05% of a run without a grant, a landed strike pair only lowers it; a run at the cap is unmeasured, never a fail or a pass). The control arm casts the same loop without the talent (801899 learned after it) and must read no 801902. Before the measured arm 801902 is cancelled on the caster and read absent with its application count, the loop's casts are the only casts and stop at the first grant, so no proc of an earlier loop turn is on; Energy and the cooldown are set before each cast. After the stop, every 50 ms the game time, the 801902 application count and its presence are read on the caster; the first read is at most 100 ms after the grant (the step checks the aura on every world update) and the remaining duration is read at the stop. The aura must be gone 15000 ms (G-19 band 14250 to 15750) after the grant, with one counted application and no recast. Annihilan Strike 801903 (40 Energy, 10000 ms category cooldown, both weapons) lands two strikes (801913, 801914); its cooldown and Energy are reset before every loop cast and the Slayer pair is the class's weapon set. An encounter timeline opened before the measured feed (after a game time read) stamps every apply of 801902 on the caster in the game time base, so the aura's age at the first read after the loop is read, not derived from the expected duration (mentor D-21, review I-1): above 100 ms, without a stamp, or with a stamped apply count other than one (a refresh or a second apply is not the stamped first apply, so the last application would be unbounded) the arm is unmeasured, except two or more stamped applies that the run's recorded timeline shows as exactly that many applies of 801902 on the caster at one game time (same_stamp_applies, tool ADR 1289, mentor D-116 and D-117), judged from that shared stamp: Annihilan Strike lands two strikes that each roll the 15% chance, so a grant can apply 801902 twice at the same game ms (fw-pair4 R2 at 12/12, flips4 reruns 2 and 6 at 3412/3412, each removed 15001 ms after the shared stamp); with n = 2 rolls a grant is double in 0.15^2 / (1 - 0.85^2) = 8.1% of runs. Applies at different game times, a recorded count that differs or no recorded timeline stay unmeasured. The timeline is process global, so the scenario runs exclusive in a batch. Reference search: coa-history spell 801899 and 801902: 0 events in 186 logs; ~/CoaServer/reference snapshots (ascension-data advancement.tsv, bindmysoul talents) list the talent without a rate or duration; nothing found for the value.

behaviours.name: Fel Haze (all enemy armor ignored under Blood of Mannoroth)
behaviours.quote: While active, Blood of Mannoroth now also causes you to ignore all enemy Armor.
behaviours.expected_source: 803903 Effect[0] aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1) EffectBasePoints 99 (+100) on Blood of Mannoroth 802075 (class mask 0x200000 of family 20, SpellFamilyFlags[0] 2097152), whose Effect[0] is aura 280 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ARMOR_PENETRATION_PCT with EffectBasePoints -1 (0%) in the DBC, moved by the Felsworn contract to aura 338 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_IGNORE_ARMOR_PCT (Felsworn ADR 0008, owner ruling Felsworn O-13 (2026-11-23)), so the stock armor penetration cap (at most (armor + K) / 3, ratio 1.5) does not apply: with the passive 100% of the armor is ignored. Carve's strike 803715 (physical weapon damage) is cast at the dummy in two arms, each hit non-critical. Increase Damage 37643 (Effect[0] aura 79 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, MiscValue 127, a stock single-effect self aura) is set on the caster in both arms with its effect 0 amount changed to 19900 (x200, a fixture size, not a claimed value) so each hit is large (about 3000 before armor) and the engine's ceil on the armored control hit adds less than 0.1%; without it a 14-16 hit rounds to 7-8 and the ratio reads about 1.95 (Felsworn ADR 0008). Lesser Armor 673 (Effect[0] aura 22 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE) is set on the dummy with its effect 0 amount changed to 5000 in both arms (a fixture size, not a claimed value) so the dummy armor reads 5528 (528 pinned reference armor plus 5000), as the Sun Cleric Vindicator 707773 ignores_armor entry. Classic combat armor mitigation at caster level 60: damage kept = K / (armor + K), K = 85 x 60 + 400 = 5500 (Unit.cpp ClassicPlusCombat::ArmorConstant). Control arm: Blood of Mannoroth 802075 set on the caster (a precondition fixture by harness set_aura, the condition of the clause, not its subject) with 803903 not learned: the full armor applies; treatment arm: 803903 learned, the same Blood: nothing is mitigated, so the mean hit ratio is (5528 + 5500) / 5500 = 2.0051 (+100.5%); band the larger of 5% of +100% and 2 points (95% to 105%), and a server ignoring 90% of the armor (ratio 1.822) or 50% (1.50) lies outside it. The expected value comes from the DBC amount and the armor formula, never from a run. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 803903: 0 events in 186 logs (passive, never logged); spell 802075 Blood of Mannoroth: SPELL_CAST_SUCCESS 33 events in 10 logs (a positive control that the active is logged; no armor figure); bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22): Fel Haze 803903 'While active, Blood of Mannoroth now also causes you to ignore all enemy Armor.', same wording as the tooltip; nothing else found.

behaviours.name: Malice of Gul'dan (Felstrike stacks cap at 3)
behaviours.quote: stacking $u times.
behaviours.observe_source: Felstrike 802678 StackAmount 3 ($u of the Felstrike description that Malice of Gul'dan 800214 includes through @s:802678:0@), DurationIndex 32 = 6000 ms (SpellDuration.dbc row 32). The Malice handler (AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp:97-98, :227-229) casts 802678 on the target after an outgoing direct (not periodic) critical damage event that passes Chance() on the raw ProcChance 60 (AscensionFelsworn.cpp:231-239), which no spell modifier forces; a stack or refresh of the same caster's 802678 goes through ModStackAmount then OnAuraApply (Unit.cpp:5465-5466). Feed: Azzinoth's Assault 803475 (the level 60 rank, GCD 1000 ms, needs 803468 and 2 Felfury per cast) at the dummy every 1100 ms; its two strikes 520262 and 572585 (melee, not Derived, AscensionFelsworn.cpp:61-69) are direct hits, made critical by the melee crit rating fixture; the class file's hit and expertise ratings remove misses, dodges and parries. Fixtures named as preconditions: Felfury 800058 x6 and 803468 set before the casts and Felfury set to 6 again after every feed cast (refeed). Control: the same five casts before 800214 is learned read 0 stacks. Treatment: 6 trials of five casts each (stack_feed), each valid with at least 4 counted applications whose poll spans stay under 6000 ms; a valid trial passes at exactly 3 stacks, never 4. Design arithmetic only (not the residual): 10 strikes at 60% leave fewer than 4 applications in 5.5% of trials if every strike crits and lands; measured: pair prove1 (build 100257c26805, 2026-11-23) v = 0/4 in both runs; pair fw-tgs2 prove (server c3bd6628a143, 2026-11-23) v = 0/4 and 1/4, so the larger v = 1/4 sizes N = 6: (1/4)^6 = 0.024%, at most 0.05%; 1.40 and 1.00, then 1.15 and 1.33 applications per feed cast in the valid trials (per cast, not per hit: the scenario reads no hit count). Reference search 2026-11-23 (fw-b1b): coa-history 802678 16516 periodic damage events, nothing for the stack count.

behaviours.observe_source: Contrast arm of haste for the condition 'While Inner Demon is active': the same main-hand attack time read 500 ms after a harmless Bless 804247 before (805236 not learned) and after a real learn of 805236, with no Inner Demon 804216 on the caster in either phase: the after time over the before time is 1.0 within 0.001, so the 15% haste (ratio 0.8696) is absent. The script toggles aura 807426 only when Inner Demon and 805236 are both on the caster (AscensionFelsworn.cpp:274). Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 805236, 807426, 807427: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive leaves no event; positive control 807554: 2923 events); the bindmysoul snapshot repeats the tooltip; nothing found that states another value.

behaviours.name: Grommash's Folly (Carve critical strikes at 10 channel steps with Inner Demon)
behaviours.quote: In addition, critical strikes with Carve deal $807427s1% increased damage, increasing up to 60% with each strike based on how long you channel.
behaviours.observe_source: 807427 Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectBasePoints 4 + EffectDieSides 1 = 5 ($807427s1); Carve 800206 channels 2500 ms (DurationIndex 66) with Effect[0] made periodic every 250 ms by the Felsworn contract (AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp:161-163), so a full channel counts 10 steps (AscensionFelswornAuras.cpp:112-118, an expired channel is forced to 10 at :210-216) and releases one Carve strike 803715 per enemy in front. AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp:192-193 multiplies a critical 803715 hit by 1 + $807427s1 / 100 x min(10, steps) when 805236 is known and Inner Demon 804216 was on the caster when the strike was cast (owner rulings Felsworn O-21 (2026-11-23) and Felsworn O-23 (2026-11-23), Felsworn ADR 0011: +5% of the whole critical hit per step, +50% at 10 steps; the tooltip's 60% is unreachable). Both arms channel Carve to its end at the one dummy with Felfury 800058 set to 4 and Inner Demon 804216 removed and set again before every trial (the harness set_aura keeps the running duration of an aura already present, and the contract gives Inner Demon 10 s: kept, it lapsed before every seventh release in the first pilot), melee crits forced and attack power +20000 (fixtures, the same in both arms), so the weapon dice (17.25-28.75 of about 3450 normalized points) move a hit under 0.2%; the treatment learns 805236 for real. The one-step arm (1.05) needs a channel cancelled after one step, which hit_ratio cannot schedule; the scenario felsworn-grommash-folly-carve-crit.json covers it. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 807427: 3 logs, 3-4 stacks per channel that expire 0.5 s after the first step, crit/non-crit median ratio 1.94-1.98 against 1.94 without the talent (no measurable bonus on live); the bindmysoul and coabuildhub snapshots repeat the tooltip with 5%; nothing found that states another value. Expected 1 + 5 x 10 / 100 = 1.5; the previous factor 0.03 per step read 1.3.

behaviours.name: Grommash's Folly (critical auto attacks heal 50% with Inner Demon)
behaviours.quote: and you now heal equal to $807426s1% of all damage dealt by critical strikes with auto attacks.
behaviours.observe_source: 807426 Effect[0] aura 354, BasePoints 49 + 1 = 50 ($807426s1); the Felsworn refresh applies 807426 while Inner Demon 804216 and 805236 are both on the caster (AscensionFelsworn.cpp:274). The event script (AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp: Check case 807426 returns Inner(player) && autoAttack && crit, :111-112; Proc case 807426 calls Copy(player, player, 560839, damage / 2), :262-263) heals the caster with 560839 (SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL). The caster auto-attacks the dummy for 3 swing intervals (8400 ms of the generated 2800 ms reference interval, the Felsworn contract gives Inner Demon DurationIndex 1, AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp:81-85, and the script sets its duration) in each phase, every swing forced critical (force_crit melee); Inner Demon is the clause's condition, removed and set again as phase auras after Felfury 800058 set to 4 stacks, 500 ms before each phase's attack. Inner Demon lasts 5000 ms x max(1, Felfury stacks) (AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp:81-85): without Felfury it ended inside the window (the first pair read 0.379 and 0.373; a diagnostic run read Inner Demon present at the attack and gone at the stop, 4 heals for 14 critical swings, each heal about half its swing), so 4 stacks give it 20000 ms, past the 500 + 8400 ms phase; 807426 was read present at the attack after the 500 ms wait (the harness set_aura keeps the running duration of an aura already present, as the crit_inner entry notes). The ratio divides the increase of the caster's 560839 heal total over the after phase by the increase of its critical swing damage (melee_damage_total critical) over it; the before phase (805236 not learned) reads 0 heal. 805236 is learned for real between the phases (mentor D-67). Reference search 2026-11-24: bindmysoul talents 805236 text 'you now heal equal to 50% of all damage dealt by critical strikes with auto attacks' (same value); coa-history spells 807426 and 560839: 0 events in 186 logs (positive control 801904 Azzinoth's Assault: 21 casts); expected values come from the tooltip and the server DBC set.

Its sibling crit_suppressed reads the critical swing damage share at 0, so the arm is not void. Code: Check case 807426 returns Inner(player) && autoAttack && crit (AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp:112-113); Proc case 807426 calls Copy(player, player, 560839, damage / 2) (:263-264). Reference search: as crit_swing_heal (bindmysoul talents 805236 text 'critical strikes with auto attacks'; coa-history 807426 and 560839: 0 events in 186 logs); expected values come from the tooltip and the server DBC set.

behaviours.name: Pit Lord's Strength 802076 (Annihilation attacks consumed)
behaviours.quote: Your Annihilation now affects $s1 additional attack
behaviours.observe_source: 802076 Effect[0] aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 4 (SPELLMOD_CHARGES), BasePoints 0 + 1 = 1 ($s1), on Annihilation 803904 (ProcCharges 5): 5 attacks without the talent (the control arm, Annihilation cast in both arms) and 6 after a real learn of 802076. Consumption read (script_count swings, mentor D-95): after each real cast of Annihilation 803904 the caster reads the script count 803904 and its landed auto attacks (melee_damage_count), auto-attacks the dummy for 2 swing intervals (4600 ms) with one main-hand Poniard 2208 (script_count main_hand, ADR 1277: item_template delay 1300 ms, Daggers 1180, skill 173; the Slayer pair of item 2027 is replaced, and melee_damage_count sums both hands, CoAGameplayTest.cpp:5314-5319), so at most 4600 // 1300 + 1 = 4 landed attacks, below every counted reading of 5 or more; the class file's hit and expertise ratings (10000) remove misses, dodges and parries, so about 4 and at least 3 attacks land, more than the 2 native charges Pit Lord's Strength 802110 gave the aura before Felsworn ADR 0030 (review fw-rbswb I-1: one landed attack per window passed with or without that fix), stops and reads both again; the judged reading is the count plus the attacks landed since the cast, valid only with at least one landed attack and a count strictly below the cast count that the landed attacks make up exactly. Code: Proc case 803904 decrements the script value on every damaging non-periodic auto attack and removes the aura at 0 (AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp:114-115, :266-275); the count is 5 plus the SPELLMOD_CHARGES mods and the native charges are cleared (AscensionFelswornAuras.cpp:77-83). The phases are 12500 ms apart, past the 12000 ms $d, so the second cast applies a fresh aura. Untested: missed or avoided swings (the rule counts landed swings only; hit and expertise ratings 10000 keep them out) and the expiry edge (the aura ending at its 6th landed attack: both hands can land up to 12 attacks in the 12000 ms $d, so the edge is reachable, but the 1-interval window stops before it, at 4 landed attacks at most; mentor D-95 accepts it untested). Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history spell 803904 finds 281 SPELL_CAST_SUCCESS by players in 15 of 186 logs (cast and aura events only, no charge count); bindmysoul and advancement.tsv give the tooltip text only; expected values come from the tooltip and the server DBC set.

behaviours.observe_source: 803904 ProcCharges 5 (Spell.dbc; $n attacks): 0 without a cast (the control arm reads the absent aura, no swings) and 5 attacks after a real cast. Consumption read (script_count swings, mentor D-95): after each real cast of Annihilation 803904 the caster reads the script count 803904 and its landed auto attacks (melee_damage_count), auto-attacks the dummy for 2 swing intervals (4600 ms) with one main-hand Poniard 2208 (script_count main_hand, ADR 1277: item_template delay 1300 ms, Daggers 1180, skill 173; the Slayer pair of item 2027 is replaced, and melee_damage_count sums both hands, CoAGameplayTest.cpp:5314-5319), so at most 4600 // 1300 + 1 = 4 landed attacks, below every counted reading of 5 or more; the class file's hit and expertise ratings (10000) remove misses, dodges and parries, so about 4 and at least 3 attacks land, more than the 2 native charges Pit Lord's Strength 802110 gave the aura before Felsworn ADR 0030 (review fw-rbswb I-1: one landed attack per window passed with or without that fix), stops and reads both again; the judged reading is the count plus the attacks landed since the cast, valid only with at least one landed attack and a count strictly below the cast count that the landed attacks make up exactly. Code: Proc case 803904 decrements the script value on every damaging non-periodic auto attack and removes the aura at 0 (AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp:114-115, :266-275); the count is 5 plus the SPELLMOD_CHARGES mods and the native charges are cleared (AscensionFelswornAuras.cpp:77-83). The phases are 12500 ms apart, past the 12000 ms $d, so the second cast applies a fresh aura. Untested: missed or avoided swings (the rule counts landed swings only; hit and expertise ratings 10000 keep them out) and the expiry edge (the aura ending at its 5th landed attack: both hands can land up to 12 attacks in the 12000 ms $d, so the edge is reachable, but the 1-interval window stops before it, at 4 landed attacks at most; mentor D-95 accepts it untested). Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history spell 803904 finds 281 SPELL_CAST_SUCCESS by players in 15 of 186 logs (cast and aura events only, no charge count); bindmysoul and advancement.tsv give the tooltip text only; expected values come from the tooltip and the server DBC set.

behaviours.name: Reckless Assault (Azzinoth's Assault damage against a slowed enemy)
behaviours.quote: Increases the damage of Azzinoth's Assault, Annihilan Strike, and Twin Slice by $s1% against slowed enemies.
behaviours.expected_source: 804610 Effect[0] aura 112, BasePoints 14 + 1 = 15 ($s1), against slowed enemies. The non-critical hits of the 520262 main-hand strike of Azzinoth's Assault 801904 (cast 803475, needs Felfury 800058 x6 and At Least 2 Felfury 803468 as precondition fixtures by set_aura) are averaged in a control arm without 804610 and a treatment arm with it learned, on a dummy slowed by Daze 38767 (aura 33 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED, set on the dummy before every cast as a precondition fixture): ratio 1.15, within the 2-point band. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 804610: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive leaves no event; positive control 801904 Azzinoth's Assault: 21 casts); advancement.tsv lists the talent name only, no values; expected values come from the tooltip and the DBC only. Sizing (2026-11-24, for the chosen sizes): the last pair read a 99% half-width of 1.27 and 1.47 points at 20 trials per arm (verdict trials_needed 33 and 44, sized_trials 51 and 68, trial limit 83), so the entry runs 80 trials per arm (min_trials 80) and the half-width falls to about 0.75 points, under half the band (1 point). The verdict states the interval it excludes; a bonus outside the band reads ok with less than a 0.5% chance per run, so a nonconformant server passes both runs of a pair with at most 0.003% probability, and a flip between the runs is not counted.

behaviours.name: Warlock Training (Crippling Pain present at 3700 ms, excludes 3600 ms)
behaviours.observe_source: 560641 Effect[0] aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectTriggerSpell 704397 (Crippling Pain, Effect[0] aura 290 MOD_CRIT_PCT -100000, DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms, $704397d); AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp:321-322 casts 704397 on the target of a landed Cripple 704371 when 560641 is known. Present 3700 ms after the Cripple cast (read time between 3650 and 3800 ms). Together with the other entry (present at 3700 ms, absent at 4300 ms) the reads exclude a duration 10% off on both sides (3600 and 4400 ms). Resist sizing (2026-11-24; the stamped entry 'Crippling Pain lasts 4 seconds' was held at 0.12^3 = 0.17% per run for a resisted Cripple, 12% on the dummy): Spell penetration 823764 ('beeg spellpen', Effect[0] aura 123 MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE -9999, school mask 126) is set on the caster in every phase (a precondition fixture, the resist is not the claim), so the effective resistance is clamped to 0 (Unit::GetEffectiveResistChance, Unit.cpp:2603-2614 and ClassicPlusCombat.h:142-146: resistance 0 gives chance 0 on both the stock and the classic path) and the binary resist of Cripple (Unit::MagicSpellHitResult, Unit.cpp:4080-4085) cannot roll; the miss roll is removed by the player fixture's spell hit rating. flips2 measured 160 of 160 phases without a resist on another binary spell (Bane of Fire 707901) with the same fixture. A resisted Cripple would read 0 here and alert, so the residual failure probability is 0 by the code path. In each phase one real cast of 707527 on the caster, then one real strike of Light of the Naaru 41394 (Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE BasePoints 1099 + 1 = 1100) cast at the caster by the striker creature 500 ms later; the damage absorbed is read in the spell logs of that strike (spell_absorb_total, as the absorbed entry of 707527). The strike is larger than the barrier in both phases (the barrier reads at most 862 without the talent and 948.2 with it, under 1100), so the absorbed damage is the whole barrier, which the strike consumes. Control arm: the before phase, the same cast and strike without 706266 known, read in 830..863 (707527 BasePoints 751 + 1 = 752, EffectDieSides 32, plus Stamina 79: 831..862). Treatment: after the learn of 706266, tooltip 'increases the absorption value of Hateforged Barrier by $s2%' = 10% ($s2 = BasePoints 9 + 1), owner ruling Felsworn O-27 (2026-11-24) / ADR 0025: one bonus only, so 831..862 x 1.10 = [914.1, 948.2]; a doubled bonus (1.21x) is excluded, as is no bonus. The expectation comes from the tooltip and the DBC, never from the stored-amount read. Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history spell 706266: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive leaves no event); 707527: 303 casts in 7 logs, no absorbed amount in a log event; nothing else found beyond the tooltip and the server DBC. The spell_absorb_total read is a running total of the logs of the strike spell, so the entry uses phase_since: the before reading counts the control phase alone and the after reading the treatment phase alone (a first pair without it read the treatment total on top of the control one, 856 + 922 = 1778 and 853 + 1018 = 1871, whose second parts are inside the ranges above). The lower edge is the integer part of the product (914): the absorb amount is an integer, so the percent bonus on the smallest roll 831 truncates (831 x 1.10 = 914.1); the bound comes from the tooltip and the DBC, not from a reading (a first pair read 997 for 707844 against the untruncated 997.2).

Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 707844: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive leaves no event); bindmysoul talents snapshot: not listed; expected values come from the tooltip and the DBC only. The absorb is rolled per cast (EffectDieSides 32: 752..783 plus Stamina 79, 831..862), so the control reading is judged in 830..863 and the treatment reading in [997.2, 1034.4] (831..862 times 1.20); a doubled bonus would read 1197..1241.

behaviours.observe_source: 805243 Infernal Whipcrack (server DBC): 'Enrage $?s800220[all][up to $i] allies within $a yds', MaxAffectedTargets 8 ($i), without 800220 learned (the aura of the cast is read right after a real cast; 800220's own SPELLMOD_MAX_TARGETS +17 does not reach 805243, mask (0,0,32) against family flags (32,0,0)). Area selection (Spell.cpp:1414-1420): each distinct target selection calls Containers::RandomResize on its candidates with the cap, and Effect[2] (15 yd) is selected apart from Effects[0-1] (20 yd). Second design, after the holder count of fw-bk6 (the caster always holds the aura through Effect[2], so a count of holders reads the cap 8 as 8 or 9): the ten raid players (the caster and nine grouped allies, all 6 yd away, inside both radii) are read by two per-unit state reads that each depend on one selection only, summed over all ten: cast_speed_multiplier for Effect[2] (the sum does not depend on which eight are drawn) and attack_time_ms of the main hand for Effect[1] (all ten carry a 2800 ms main-hand weapon, so the sum does not depend on which eight are drawn). With ten candidates and a cap of 8, exactly eight are drawn in each selection. The read before the cast is the control: no aura, 10 and 28000. The main read is the caster's spell_cast_count of 805243 (0 before, 1 after the real cast): it does not depend on which eight are drawn, so the check has no draw-dependent label (the first draft read the aura on the caster, which misses it 4% per run because the caster is one of ten candidates drawn with 8 of 10 in each of two selections). The proof of the cap is the per-effect sums of the arms, which hold for every draw; the residual failure probability of the draw is 0 per pair. Residual false-pass: a cap other than 8 passes only when two of the ten players silently fail to be candidates (not alive or out of range, both read as preconditions; raid membership is the grouping step of the scenario, not read) in both selections at once, since a cap of 9 or 7 or none moves the sum by 0.09 or 254 ms or more; the per-unit reads of the 9 archived runs (prove3 x2, prove4 x2, focus x5, fw-rd288 review) show every one of the ten players holding an effect in at least one run, with changing non-holder pairs, so no player is a persistent non-candidate. Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history spell 805243: 0 events in 186 logs; sidekick, bindmysoul, ascension-data and coabuildhub snapshots list the talent and its 800220 tooltip only, no target count; expected values come from the tooltip and the DBC only.

behaviours.name: Bane of Chaos (only one Bane on a target)
behaviours.quote: Can only have 1 Bane active on a target at a time.
behaviours.observe_source: Bane of Fire 707901 (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 32, the Bane family mask of Bane of Chaos 706420) is cast at the dummy in both phases. The before phase casts no second Bane: Bane of Fire is on the dummy (the control, read 1). The after phase casts Bane of Chaos at the same dummy 1700 ms later: Bane of Fire is gone (read 0), so a second Bane replaces the first. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 706420: 324 casts, 206 aura applied and 206 removed in 2 logs (113 refreshes), no figure for the exclusivity; nothing else found. Precondition (after_setup_stacks, ADR 1257): Bane of Fire 707901 is read on the dummy at exactly 1 stack right after its setup cast in each phase, before the before reading and before the Bane of Chaos cast; a run where it did not land is void, not judged (the run-1 flip read 0 before the learn). No roll decides the judged reading: the removal is the aura apply handler AscensionFelswornAuras.cpp:48-58, which removes every other Bane of the same caster on the target when a Bane (AscensionFelsworn.cpp:114-117) applies, with no chance; the caster's spell hit rating 10000 (class file ratings) lifts HitChance to the 10000 clamp of Unit::MagicSpellHitResult (Unit.cpp:4039-4053), so the miss roll threshold is 0. Run evidence (fw-vb2b, 2026-11-24): in the archived failing run (stamp 20261124-000202) the first Bane of Fire cast of the scenario (step 33) was submitted without a cast failure (the result has no cast_failures) and 707901 read 0 on the dummy 1700 ms later, while the identical second cast (step 44) read 1: the cast was accepted and the aura did not land, which is a spell miss or resist, not a refused cast. Bane of Fire is DmgClass 1, school 4, and the dummy's fire resistance can make it a binary resist; spell penetration 823764 (aura 123, MiscValue 126, -9999) is therefore a named precondition fixture in both phases, as in the sibling entries. This is a hypothesis tested by the focused reruns, not a proven cause.

behaviours.observe_source: Felsworn ADR 0023 (owner ruling Felsworn O-30 (2026-11-24)): every Azzinoth's Assault under Inner Demon extends Inner Demon 804216 by $/1000;803089s1 = 3 sec flat (803089 Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_DURATION, BasePoints 2999 + 1 = 3000 ms), with no attack power term. 803475 casts 803089 on the caster for its hit while Inner Demon is active (AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp:356-357). Fixtures in each phase, in this order: Felfury 800058 x2 (the Assault's cost), then Inner Demon 804216 by harness set_aura, then 803468: Inner Demon starts at 5000 ms x max(1, Felfury) = 10000 ms (AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp:72-73; fw-f2 diagnostic and pair prove-4: 9994 ms read right after the fixtures), so it ends 13000 ms after the fixtures with one extension and 10000 ms without. The before reading is the presence right after the fixtures, before the cast (cast_in_before false: the cast is the contrast). The after reading, in game time after the cast: present at 12835 ms (window 12825 to 12860) and absent at 13145 ms (window 13135 to 13165), so the extension lies between about 2835 and 3165 ms against the stated 3000 ms, excluding a value 10% off and the 10000 ms end without extension. Companion arms on the same fixtures: extend and extend_ap (the remaining duration, gain 2885 against 2900), extend_absent (no Inner Demon) and extend_casts (one 803089 per Assault). Reference search 2026-11-23 (fix-250/note.md section 5): nothing decides the value beyond the tooltip and Spell.dbc; the owner ruled Felsworn O-30 on 2026-11-24.

behaviours.name: Mark of Chaos (consumed by the next Sargeron Smite)
behaviours.observe_source: Learned route, no set_aura (mentor D-67). Chaos Rush 500028 is cast for real at the dummy after the learn (setup cast; the grant of 525027 is also shown by aura_held and grant_amount); the aura is read present right after the setup (after_setup_reads, a precondition: a refused dash or a consumption by the dash itself would make the run unmeasured). The first learned design failed once on SPELL_FAILED_UNIT_NOT_INFRONT (134): Chaos Rush 500028 triggers Chaos Rush Jump 802028, Effect[0] CHARGE_DEST on TARGET_DEST_CASTER_FRONT with radius index 13 = 10 yd (SpellRadius.dbc), so the dash carries the caster 10 yd along its facing, past the dummy that stands 3 yd ahead; Sargeron Smite 802060 has FacingCasterFlags 1. The fix is relocate_before_trigger dx -10 (the caster returns to its start before the Smite). Select for 525027 is Direct || Named 801904 || Twin (AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp:30-31): the Smite is the only consumer cast, and the kept control casts Demonic Will 800209, which is not one. The read after the Smite is 0 against 1 in the kept control with the identical setup. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 525027: 1 log, 9 applied and 9 removed, no value in a log event; expected values come from the tooltip and the DBC only.

behaviours.name: Fury of Archimonde (consumed by the next Sargeron Smite)
behaviours.observe_source: Learned route, no set_aura (mentor D-67). The five real generators Burning Hatred 805239, Demonic Will 800209 twice, Felhoof Charge 800204 and Bane of Chaos 706420 are cast after the learn (6 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 10 Felfury, the ten_felfury entry), Energy refilled after each; 706269 is read present after the setup (after_setup_reads, a precondition). The earlier failed attempt recorded Smite 800200 as refused: the cast_failures list names spell 800200 = Felhoof Charge (Spell.dbc), the secondary cast of Felhoof Charge 800204, reason 27 SPELL_FAILED_DONT_REPORT; it recurs in every 706425 entry, the passing ten_felfury included, so it does not stop the generation, and it made the old void_on_cast_failure flag void the trial. The first attempt lacked Bane of Chaos (9 generated, aura absent); the second removed the Felfury fixture 800058 and the Smite was refused SPELL_FAILED_NO_POWER (85) in that run (cause not isolated further); with the fixture restored the refusal did not recur. The fixture is a precondition of the Smite (consumes 2 Felfury), not the subject. void_on_cast_failure is dropped: a refused Smite would leave the aura at 1 and read as an alert, not a pass. Select for 706269 is Named 802060 (AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp:22-24). The read after the Smite is 0 against 1 in the kept control. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 706269 and 706425: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive and its aura leave no event); expected values come from the tooltip and the DBC only.

behaviours.name: Doomstride (the curse resist chance is doubled at full health)
behaviours.quote: While at full health, your chance to resist the next Curse or Magic effect on you is increased by 100%.
behaviours.observe_source: Owner ruling Felsworn O-28 (2026-11-24, Felsworn ADR 0026): 'increased by 100%' doubles the base chance ('Increased "by", not "to"'); mentor D-93: the server rolls the stock hit result a second time (AscensionFelsworn.cpp ResistDebuff, Unit::SpellHitResult), a miss or resist of that roll resists the effect, so the full-health chance is 1 - (1 - p)^2 = 2p - p^2, a stated engine approximation of 2p (Felsworn ADR 0026). A level 60 striker (creature 36, no spell hit bonus) casts Curse of Weakness 702 (Dispel 2 curse, DmgClass 1 magic, two APPLY_AURA effects) at the caster once per trial; the stock chance p is the same-level spell miss: Unit::MagicSpellHitResult gives 96 - levelDiff = 96% hit at levelDiff 0 (Unit.cpp:3995-3998), so p = 0.04 and the full-health chance is 0.0784; the earlier same-level control read 3.7% of 4000 trials (merged/fw-ea1/prove2). The control arm runs before 804613 is learned (a real learn, D-91, no set_aura of the talent); the treatment at full health and the low-health arm at 90% health after it. 706818, the 10 s lockout the resist casts, is removed before every strike (a precondition fixture: each trial is the first effect after a rest; the lockout is the resist_lockout entry). Arms sized by the exact binomial false-fail through the judge (review fw-rf1b I-2b: the earlier normal-approximation sizing, 3860 / 7270 / 3860 trials, failed a conformant claim with probability 4.5e-3 per pair): 4466 / 7656 / 4466 trials (11 parts of 406 / 696 / 406), each arm leaving its G-20 band with probability at most 1.67e-4 per run (exact: control and low health 1.62e-4, treatment 1.66e-4), so a conformant server fails this claim with probability 9.79e-4 per counted pair (3 arms x 2 runs). Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 804613 and 706818: 0 events in 186 logs; bindmysoul talents snapshot lists 804613 with another text ('Using Chaos Rush twice in a row now refreshes a charge of Chaos Rush.'); the installed DBC wins over a snapshot (general rules).

behaviours.name: Scars of Suffering (scar amount, Agility contrast arm)
behaviours.quote: increasing your allies' attack power against them by ${$m1+0+$AGI*0.15}
behaviours.observe_source: Agility contrast arm of the scar_amount entry (Felsworn ADR 0010, owner ruling Felsworn O-20 (2026-11-23)): the talent text ${$m1+0+$AGI*0.15} reads $m1 from 570158 Effect[0] (EffectBasePoints -1, EffectDieSides 1: 0), so the scar 570159 Effect[0] aura 165 SPELL_AURA_MELEE_ATTACK_POWER_ATTACKER_BONUS carries 0.15 x the caster's Agility and nothing else. Agility 58451 (aura 29 SPELL_AURA_MOD_STAT, MiscValue 1, EffectBasePoints 29, EffectDieSides 1: +30) is set on the caster in both phases with Felfury 800058 at 6 stacks, so the reference Agility 130 (class file stat 1) becomes 160: 0.15 x 160 = 24, judged to 1. The control arm is the read before the learn (0: no scar without the talent). The aura amount is the attack power every attacker gains against the scarred target: Unit::GetTotalAttackPowerValue adds victim->GetTotalAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_MELEE_ATTACK_POWER_ATTACKER_BONUS) (Unit.cpp:13786). The pair with scar_amount separates the Agility slope (0.15 x 30 = 4.5) from a flat base: the stock 570159 base and per-level points (4 + 1 + int32(43 x 0.5) = 26 at level 60) would read 45 and 50.

behaviours.name: Scars of Suffering (allies' white swing against the scarred target)

behaviours.expected_source: 570159 Effect[0] aura 165 SPELL_AURA_MELEE_ATTACK_POWER_ATTACKER_BONUS carries 0.15 x Agility (ADR felsworn/0010): int32(0.15 x 130) = 19 at the class file reference Agility 130 (stat 1). The engine consumes it in Unit::MeleeDamageBonusDone (Unit.cpp:11525, 11540): a plain white swing gains int32(19 / 14 x weapon speed 2.3) = int32(3.12) = 3 flat before armor, while the weapon roll already holds the reference attack power. Weapon 2027 (class file weapon: 17.25-28.75, mean 23, speed 2300 ms) at reference attack power 312: control mean 23 + 312 / 14 x 2.3 = 74.257; with the scar 77.257; expected mean ratio 1.0404 (armor multiplies both arms alike); 1.0 if the white swing does not read the scar, 1.0943 with the pre-fix scar of 45 (int32(7.39) = 7). Band: the larger of 5% of the stated bonus and 2 points (+2.04% to +6.04%), which excludes both no gain and the pre-fix scar. Treatment: Azzinoth's Assault 801904 is cast at the dummy before every swing with 570158 learned (the scar is cast by it, AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp:214); control: no learn and no cast. Felfury 800058 x6 and At Least 2 Felfury 803468 are set on the caster in both arms before every trial (named precondition fixtures: Azzinoth's Assault needs 803468 and consumes Felfury; Felfury carries haste auras 192/216 and 214 only, no damage term), and the plain (not critical, not glancing) main-hand hits are read, as in the Witch Hunter precedent 804068 ap_melee_swing (WH ADR 0024). A second Agility value is not run: +30 Agility (58451) gives int32(24 / 14 x 2.3) = 3 flat as well, so the white swing cannot separate it from 19 (the Agility slope stays on scar_amount_agility, data). The aura amount entries scar_amount and scar_amount_agility stay as the value readback. Reference search 2026-11-23: see scar_amount (coa-history 570158 / 570159: 0 events in 186 logs; bindmysoul talents snapshot: 15% of Agility for 10 seconds); nothing else found.

behaviours.quote: increasing your allies' attack power against them by ${$m1+0+$AGI*0.15}
behaviours.expected_source: Regression of Felsworn ADR 0015 (mentor D-68). The entry is keyed to 570158 so it runs with the Slayer set (spell_weapon_sets): under the Tyrant set of 805240 (item 2529, subclass 8) Azzinoth's Assault 801904 fails with SPELL_FAILED_EQUIPPED_ITEM_CLASS (29; 801904 EquippedItemClass 2, SubClassMask 41105), so the D-61 diagnostic keyed to 805240 (453 in both arms, pair 20261123-194225 / 20261123-194305) never scarred the dummy (fw-fixvap diagnostic: 570159 absent at all 80 treatment casts, cast_failure 29). Tyrant's Gaze has no weapon requirement (EquippedItemClass -1). The quote is the scar's (570158); the observed Gaze 805240 tooltip reads ${$m1+0+$AP*0.35}; m1 = 219 + 1 + 4.0 x (60 - 29) = 344 and attack power 312 give 344 + int(0.35 x 312 = 109.2) = 453 in the control arm. With the scar the victim carries int32(0.15 x 130) = 19 attack power against it: 344 + int(0.35 x 331 = 115.85) = 459, expected mean ratio 1.01325 (+6 per hit); 1.0 if the class reads attack power without the victim, as the scaling hook alone does (felsworn_scaling::ModifySpellEffectBaseValue has no target); the victim term is added per target in felsworn_casts::OnSpellCalculatedTarget. The +6 per hit is int(0.35 x 19 = 6.65) with no damage modifier in either arm (control 453 = 344 + 109 exactly), so truncation cannot hide it: a single hit separates 453 from 459. Same fixtures as the 805240 damage entry (crit removed by 984954, partial resists by 823764, dummy below 35% health: 30%). Azzinoth's Assault 801904 is cast at the dummy before every Gaze in the treatment arm with 570158 learned. Reference search 2026-11-23: see the 805240 damage entry (coa-history: 13 casts, no decisive figure); nothing found on the scar.

Gaze tooltip ${$m1+0+$AP*0.35}: m1 = 219 + 1 + 4.0 x (60 - 29) = 344, attack power 312: before (no scar) 344 + int(0.35 x 312 = 109.2) = 453 (the 805240 damage entry); after, the scar int32(0.15 x 130) = 19 (570159 row {570159, 0, agility 0.15}, reference Agility 130): 344 + int(0.35 x 331 = 115.85) = 459. spell_damage_total is cumulative, so the after reading is 453 + 459 = 912 and the judged gain is the after phase's single hit, 459 within 1: no victim term gives 453, a doubled term 344 + int(0.35 x 350 = 122.5) = 466. behaviours.name: Scars of Suffering (off-hand Azzinoth's Assault strike against the scarred target)
behaviours.quote: increasing your allies' attack power against them by ${$m1+0+$AGI*0.15}
behaviours.expected_source: Regression of review fw-rfvap I1 (Felsworn ADR 0015): the victim term of a NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG row follows the spell's attack type as Spell.cpp:597-603 sets it. Off-hand strike 572585 (AttributesEx3 0x1000200 with SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_OFF_HAND_WEAPON, DmgClass 2, SchoolMask 1, Effect[0] 121, row {572585, 0, ap 0.145}) is cast by Azzinoth's Assault 801904 Effect[1] (TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE, BasePoints 21 + 1 = 22) with the Slayer set (two swords 2027, 17.25-28.75, normalized speed 2.4). Both phases cast one 801904 at the dummy; the after phase adds the scar 570159 (aura 165) on the dummy with its amount set to 200100 instead of the 19 of the talent (570158 is not learned: gate_spell 801904 is already known, so no real scar replaces the fixture). Victim term: int32(0.145 x 200100 = 29014.5) = 29014, times UNIT_MOD_DAMAGE_OFFHAND TOTAL_PCT 0.5 (Unit.cpp:519; SpellEffects.cpp:4689-4708 for the fixed bonus) = 14507; the main-hand modifier would give 29014. Strike without the scar, C (Spell::EffectWeaponDmg): fixed bonus CalcValue(22 - 1 + 1 = 22) + 0.145 x 312 = 67.24, int 67, times 0.5 = 33 (int); normalized off-hand weapon damage (StatSystem CalculateMinMaxDamage) ((312 / 14 x 2.4 = 53.49) + 17.25 to 28.75) x 0.5 = 35.37 to 41.12, urand(35, 41); C = 68 to 74, no Felsworn damage factor applies (DamageFactor needs auras the fixture lacks). Stock adds its own victim term to a weapon spell in Unit::MeleeDamageBonusDone (Unit.cpp:11527-11542): int32(200100 / 14 x GetAPMultiplier = normalized speed 2.4 = 34302.86) = 34302 flat, not scaled by the off-hand percent; the class share is a marginal share of the same function (Share: bonus(2x) - bonus(x)), so it does not repeat that flat. The before reading is one strike, at least 68; the judged gain is the after phase's strike C + 34302 + 14507 = 48877 to 48883: 48880 within 3. Without the class victim term the gain is 34370 to 34376; with the main-hand modifier 63384 to 63390. The first pair of this entry (prove4, expected 14578 without the stock flat term) read 70 and 73 before and a gain of 48882 in both runs. Fixtures named as preconditions in both phases: Felfury 800058 x6 and 803468 (801904 needs 803468 and consumes 2 Felfury); 984954 Effect[0] aura 52 set to -1000 (no melee crit, as the Witch Doctor precedent); Fel Blades 300482 (aura 101 armor) set to -100 on the dummy (armor 0, so armor cannot scale the term); Hammer of Justice 853 on the dummy (a stunned target cannot block, Unit.cpp:3937-3940); hit and expertise ratings 10000 from the class file remove misses, dodges and parries. Vengeful Pact 803885 Description: 'Emanate an aura that increases nearby allies' Shadow Resistance by ${$m1+0}', Effect[0] aura 143 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE_EXCLUSIVE, MiscValue 32 (Shadow), BasePoints 64 + 1 = 65, area aura on the party (SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID, radius index 23). Behaviour read: a real Vengeful Pact cast by the caster; the Shadow resistance of the grouped ally (resistance, school 5, a live stat read) is read before the cast (no Pact, 0) and after it. The control entry (pact_resist) has no Pact Hunter; the treatment entry (pact_resist_hunter) has Pact Hunter learned in both phases: 65 + 50% = 97.5, read as the integer 97 (the engine's integer percent modifier, tolerance 0.5 judges to the rounding, G-19). Evidence class: a stat read whose promise words ('resistance') the claim does not carry, so the audit counts it as data (163.0 stays uncounted): a second design, the damage shield hit of Vengeful Pact's Effect[1] read after a real Damage 100 (TEST) 2653 cast by the dummy at the Pact holder (the caster, and a grouped ally), read no shield hit and no health loss on the dummy. Demonfire Pact's +3 crit chance reads +4 with Pact Hunter (3 x 1.5 = 4.5 truncated). Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spells 704612 and 803885: 0 events in 186 logs; nothing found beyond the tooltip and Spell.dbc.

behaviours.name: Archimonde's Wrath (Ruin critical strike share rises by 10 points at 100 Energy)
behaviours.quote: Increases the critical strike chance of your Felfury spenders by $s2% for every 10 points of Energy you have at the time of casting.
behaviours.observe_source: Archimonde's Wrath 300489 Description: 'Increases the critical strike chance of your Felfury spenders by $s2% for every 10 points of Energy you have at the time of casting.' Effect[1] BasePoints 0 + 1 = 1 ($s2 = 1). With 100 Energy at the time of casting the stated bonus is 10 x 1 = 10 critical strike points on Ruin 801895, a Felfury spender (it consumes 2 Felfury). Behaviour read: critical over all hits of the observed Ruin, control arm (300489 not learned) against treatment arm (300489 learned), the difference of the two rates judged in percent points inside the G-19 band of the stated 10 (2 points), pooled over parts of 300 casts per arm (ADR 0195); Energy is set to 100 before every cast; Felfury x2 and spell penetration 823764 are named precondition fixtures. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 300489: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive leaves no event); nothing found beyond the tooltip and Spell.dbc. Sizing 2026-11-24: the 99% half-width of the difference must stay under 1 point (half of the 2-point band). One scenario holds at most 65 casts (the pilot caps them there), so only the number of parts can lower it. At 140 parts the half-width read 0.856, 0.884, 0.853, 0.961, 0.875, 1.01, 0.948 and 0.934 over 8 runs (mean 0.915, sd 0.057, relative 6.2%), so one run in eight was not judged; the half-width falls as 1/sqrt(parts), so 200 parts give about 0.77 and the limit lies 5 standard deviations away (a 30% margin over a 6.2% spread): residual failure probability below 1e-5 per run, 2e-5 per pair, under the 0.1% per pair target.

behaviours.name: Archimonde's Wrath (Assault critical strike share rises by 5 points at 50 Energy)
behaviours.quote: Increases the critical strike chance of your Felfury spenders by $s2% for every 10 points of Energy you have at the time of casting.
behaviours.observe_source: Archimonde's Wrath 300489 Description: 'Increases the critical strike chance of your Felfury spenders by $s2% for every 10 points of Energy you have at the time of casting.' Effect[1] BasePoints 0 + 1 = 1 ($s2 = 1). Azzinoth's Assault 803475 is a Felfury spender with an instant cast (CastingTimeIndex 1 = SpellCastTimes 1 = 0 ms, Spell.dbc /srv/coa/server-data/dbc), so the Energy at the start of the cast and at its completion are the same and no regeneration runs between them. Energy is set to 50 before every cast; the tooltip then gives 50 / 10 x 1 = 5 critical strike points on the main-hand strike 520262 of Assault, judged inside the G-19 band of 2 points (3 to 7), which excludes the flat +10 that a script ignoring the Energy would give and the +0 of a passive that does nothing. Regeneration between the Energy step and the cast would only add to the 50 and leaves 5 for any value from 50 to 59. Behaviour read: critical over all hits of 520262, control arm (300489 not learned, same Felfury 800058 x6 and 803468 fixtures) against treatment arm (300489 learned), the difference of the two rates in percent points, pooled over parts of 80 casts per arm. Fixtures by harness set_aura, named as preconditions: Felfury 800058 x6 and 803468 before each cast of Assault 803475 (it needs 803468), in both arms. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 300489: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive leaves no event; positive control 801904 Azzinoth's Assault: 21 casts); ~/CoaServer/reference holds only talent listings, no behaviour text; nothing found on the moment the Energy is read. Untested, by design: whether 'at the time of casting' means the start or the completion of a cast on a spender with a cast time (Ruin 801895, 2.5 s); the 100 Energy arm on Ruin cannot tell, since Energy is capped at 100 at both moments.

behaviours.name: Doomstride (the resist occurs at most once every 10 sec)
behaviours.quote: Can only occur once every 10 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: Owner ruling Felsworn O-28 (2026-11-24, Felsworn ADR 0026): 'increased by 100%' doubles the base chance ('Increased "by", not "to"'); mentor D-93: the server rolls the stock hit result a second time (AscensionFelsworn.cpp ResistDebuff, Unit::SpellHitResult), a miss or resist of that roll resists the effect, so the full-health chance is 1 - (1 - p)^2 = 2p - p^2, a stated engine approximation of 2p (Felsworn ADR 0026). Mentor D-93: the 10 s lockout 706818 is cast when the second roll resists (the mentor's reading of 'Can only occur once every 10 sec', not an owner ruling); 706818 lasts SpellDuration index 1 = 10000 ms (AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp). Design 2 of clause 282 (design 1, two prime gaps against a striker with a spell hit bonus of 100, relied on the guaranteed resist Felsworn O-28 (2026-11-24, Felsworn ADR 0026) removed: with p = 0 the passive never resists). 804613 is learned (real learn) and the caster stays at full health. A level 56 striker (creature 36, no spell hit bonus; an open-world creature is shown to a level 60 character at least at 60 - 4 = 56, LocalLevelScaling.h:314-319, and Creature::getLevelForTarget rolls the hit at that level) gives levelDiff 4 and p = 1 - (94 - (4 - 2) x 7)% = 0.20 (Unit.cpp:3995-3998, Rate.MissChanceMultiplier.TargetPlayer 7 in the test worldserver.conf). The first run of this design used a level 54 striker with p = 0.34 and missed the scaling floor: it read 0.19 / 0.17 on primed trials and 0.344 / 0.356 on the others (pair fw-f1/prove1), which is p = 0.20 and 1 - (1 - 0.20)^2 = 0.36. A trial is primed when the priming 702 leaves 706818 on the caster (share (1 - p) p = 0.16). Locked arm: the judged 702 300 ms after the primed read resists at p on primed trials and at 1 - (1 - p)^2 = 0.36 on the others; each group's Wilson interval at z 3.93 holds its own chance and its Wilson 99% interval excludes the other (minimum 642 trials per group; 460 trials x 10 parts give about 736 primed, 3.8 standard deviations above it), and the primed share of the locked trials holds (1 - p) p = 0.16 in the z 3.93 interval, so a lockout started by any landed effect (share (1 - p)^2 = 0.64) alerts (review fw-rf1 I-3; pair fw-f1/prove2 read 0.160 and 0.158). A conformant server fails the locked label with probability at most 6.4e-4 per counted pair: 5.0e-4 from the 3 holds, 1.4e-4 from a group below its minimum, under 1e-8 from an interval that keeps the other chance (normal approximation; review fw-rf1 I-1). Expiry arm: on primed trials 706818 is on the caster 9500 ms after the priming strike and gone at 10500 ms. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 804613 and 706818: 0 events in 186 logs; bindmysoul talents snapshot lists 804613 with another text ('Using Chaos Rush twice in a row now refreshes a charge of Chaos Rush.'); the installed DBC wins over a snapshot (general rules).

behaviours.name: Tyrannical Resolve (the closing Felfire Blast deals more after more hits)
behaviours.quote: When this ends, you unleash a Felfire Blast that leeches health from nearby enemies based on how many times you took damage with the effect active.
behaviours.observe_source: 804823 Tyrannical Resolve: on its removal while the caster lives (not by death) the server counts the strikes absorbed during the effect (script value 804823, one per absorbed damage event, aura_ascension_felsworn_resolve in AscensionFelswornAuras.cpp) and, since owner ruling Felsworn O-32 (2026-11-24) (Felsworn ADR 0028), casts Felfire Blast 804825 (Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_HEALTH_LEECH, EffectValueMultiplier 1.0, TARGET_SRC_CASTER / TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ENEMY, RadiusIndex 13, MaxAffectedTargets 20, SchoolMask 36, DmgClass 2 melee) with its own points raised by 804823 Effect[0] (aura 108 SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, BasePoints 1 + DieSides 1 = 2%) per hit, capped at 804823 StackAmount 100. Its own points at the level-60 reference character: BasePoints 59 + RealPointsPerLevel 1.44 x (60 - SpellLevel 59) = 60, + DieSides 2 roll = 61 to 62; with the hits: 62 to 63 at one hit, 64 to 65 at three, 67 to 68 at five. Before Felsworn O-32 (2026-11-24, Felsworn ADR 0028) the server cast Burning Hatred 807347 for 1% of maximum health per hit (measured 200 at one hit and 600 at three, L1 pair, night question N-6). Each trial: the caster is set to 20000 of 20000 health, casts 804823, a passive striker 3 yd away casts Light of the Naaru 41394 (1100) at it 1, 3 or 5 times, then the trial waits 31000 ms past the 30000 ms duration (DurationIndex 9) for the natural end. Fixtures on the caster in every arm: 64481 (Reduce Critical Strike Chance -100%, aura 52, EffectBasePoints -1000: 804825 is DmgClass melee, whose crit is the weapon crit, so a critical blast cannot double one arm's read) Reg's Hit rating 984948 (aura 54, no miss) and beeg spellpen 823764 (Effect[0] aura 123 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE, MiscValue 126, BasePoints -9999: the striker's Fire and Shadow resistance cannot partially resist the blast; a first fw-f3 pair without it read 10% steps below the expected figures, 45 to 68). A zero arm takes no strike (M-3 of review fw-rf3): the blast still fires at the natural end with its own points, 61 to 62 (the tooltip's 'When this ends, you unleash a Felfire Blast' has no hit condition; ADR 0028). Judged per trial: exactly one 804825 hit on the striker and no 807347 hit; the 804825 damage inside the arm's band read from the data above (zero 61 to 62, one 62 to 63, three 64 to 65, five 67 to 68: 61 or 62 times 1 + 0.02 n, truncated); the caster's 804825 heal equals that damage (multiplier 1.0). The bands replace the strict rise of the first design (review fw-rf3 I-1: a rise alone also passed N-6 option A, 1% of maximum health per hit, 200 / 600 / 1000); bands one, three and five are disjoint and ordered, so the rise still holds. Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history spell 804823, 804825, 807347, 'Felfire Blast', 'Burning Hatred': 0 events in 186 logs each; ~/CoaServer/reference snapshots carry only the 804823 tooltip text; expected values come from the tooltip, the DBC and the owner ruling.

behaviours.name: Azzinoth's Rage 804611 (armor penetration 10%)
behaviours.quote: Increases your Armor penetration by $s1%
behaviours.expected_source: $s1 = 10 (804611 Effect[0] aura 280 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ARMOR_PENETRATION_PCT, EffectBasePoints 9 + DieSides 1, EquippedItemClass -1, EffectMiscValue 0, Spell.dbc). The engine's stock rule (Unit.cpp CalcArmorReducedDamage, no Felsworn code for this aura): the armor removed is the sum of aura 280 times the cap maxArmorPen = min((armor + C) / 3, armor), C = 85 x level + 400 = 5500 at level 60 (ClassicPlusCombat::ArmorConstant), not that percent of the armor; the hit is reduced by r / (1 + r), r = armor / C. Carve's strike 803715 (physical weapon damage, mitigated by armor) is cast at the dummy in two arms; each hit non-critical. Increase Damage 37643 (Effect[0] aura 79, MiscValue 127) is set on the caster in both arms with its effect 0 amount 19900 and Lesser Armor 673 effect 0 amount 5000 on the dummy in both arms (fixture sizes, not claimed values; same fixtures as the 803903 ignores_armor entry), so the dummy armor is 528 pinned reference armor + 5000 = 5528 and each hit is large enough that the engine's ceil adds under 0.1%. Control arm: 804611 not learned, the full armor 5528 applies, kept = C / (5528 + C). Treatment arm: 804611 learned, cap = (5528 + 5500) / 3 = 3676, armor removed 10% of 3676, kept = C / (5528 - 0.1 x 3676 + C). Ratio = 11028 / (11028 x (1 - 0.1/3)) = 1 / (1 - 0.1/3) = 30/29 = 1.034483 (+3.45%), independent of the armor as long as it exceeds C / 2. Band: the larger of 5% of the gain and 2 points; a server ignoring 10% of the full armor instead of 10% of the cap would read 1.0528, and a missing aura reads 1.0. Expected from the DBC amount and the formula, never from a run. The dummy level and the armor read in the run replace these figures if they differ. Control arm: the same entry without 804611. Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history spell 804611: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive leaves no event); ~/CoaServer/reference snapshots (bindmysoul, ascension-data advancement.tsv and coabuildhub index) list the talent name only, no values; expected values come from the tooltip and the DBC only.

behaviours.observe_source: Consume Magic 800353 Description: 'Steal $s1 beneficial magic effect' (Effect[0] aura/effect 126 STEAL_BENEFICIAL_BUFF, BasePoints 0 + DieSides 1 = 1 stolen) and 704613 Effect[0] aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1), + 1 ($s1) on Consume Magic (SpellFamilyFlags[2] 8192): the cast steals 1 effect without the talent, 2 with it. Three stock beneficial Magic buffs (Dispel 1 in Spell.dbc), Power Word: Fortitude 1243, Mark of the Wild 1126 and Arcane Intellect 1459, are set on the dummy (precondition fixtures, by the dummy) and removed from the caster at the start of both phases; a real Consume Magic cast at the dummy follows, 500 ms later carried_aura_count of the three auras on the caster is read: 1 before the learn (control), 2 after; a third stolen aura (an over-steal) reads 3. The only caster aura is fixture 823764 (spell penetration and a family-33 SPELLMOD_EFFECT1), which cannot reach Consume Magic (family 20); the control arm reading 1 confirms it. Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history spell 704613: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive leaves no event); ~/CoaServer/reference snapshots (bindmysoul, ascension-data advancement.tsv and coabuildhub index) list the talent name only, no values; expected values come from the tooltip and the DBC only.

behaviours.name: Nether Champion (five stacks raise Sargeron Smite damage by 40%)
behaviours.quote: Triggering Dancing Blades now increases the damage of next Sargeron Smite by $705146s1%
behaviours.expected_source: $705146s1 = 8 (705146 Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, BasePoints 7 + 1 = 8 per stack, StackAmount 5 = $705146u): five stacks add 8 x 5 = 40% to the damage of the spell its class mask names, a percent modifier that sums with other additive modifiers: expected ratio 1.40 of a Sargeron Smite 802060 hit with five stacks over the same hit without. The stacks are set on the caster by the harness (set_aura 705146 x5, a named precondition fixture; its grant by Dancing Blades and its 5-stack cap are proven by the stack_amount, stack_cap and consumed entries, and its own real-path grant is not the subject here). Increase Damage 37643 (aura 79 MiscValue 127) at amount 19900 is set in both arms, so each hit large so the engine's ceil adds under 0.1% (fixture size, not a claimed value). Control arm: no 705146. Band: the larger of 5% of the +40% gain and 2 points. Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history spell 705146 and 802060: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive leaves no event); ~/CoaServer/reference snapshots (bindmysoul, ascension-data advancement.tsv and coabuildhub index) list the talent name only, no values; expected values come from the tooltip and the DBC only. Sargeron Smite 802060 (CasterAuraSpell 803468, 'Consumes 2 Felfury'): Felfury 800058 x6 and 803468 are set on the caster before every cast in both arms (the spender's cost and caster aura, precondition fixtures). Sizing: the pilot of the first pair measured a per-hit spread (the Shadowflame hit takes the engine's partial resists) that needs 2429 trials per arm for the 99% half-width to stay at half the band (the verdict's own trials_needed), so the entry runs 15 parts of 100 trials. Sizing (2026-11-24, replaces the 15 parts of 100 above): the last pair pooled 1500 trials per arm and read a 99% half-width of 1.23 and 1.25 points against the 1 point the judge needs (verdict trials_needed 2261 and 2357, sized_trials 3532 and 3683), so the entry runs 26 parts of 150 trials (3900 per arm, one scenario holds 166): the half-width falls to about 0.78 points. The verdict states the interval it excludes; a bonus outside the band reads ok with less than a 0.5% chance per run, so a nonconformant server passes both runs of a pair with at most 0.003% probability, and a flip between the runs is not counted.

Fixtures as in the 570158 entry: 984954 removes crits, 823764 partial resists, the dummy sits at 34% then 30% health (Gaze). Per hit the expected critical is 2 x (mean of the integer rolls + 50): the Tyrant roll ints (min and max truncated, Unit.cpp:3626) at attack power 312 are 147 to 176 (mean 161.5, hit 423) and at 20312 are 4861 to 4890 (mean 4875.5, hit 9851), so the sums are 10 x 423 = 4230 and 10 x 9851 = 98510. The standard deviation of the sum of 10 critical hits is 2 x 8.6 x sqrt(10) = 54.4 (roll uniform over 29.7 points, doubled by the critical). One read accepts a flat of 40 or 60 only if the sum falls 55 or more toward the window from the wrong mean: z = (200 - 145) / 54.4 = 1.01, probability 0.156 per read. The pair holds 4 independent reads (2 runs x 2 attack power arms), so the residual failure probability of accepting a flat of 40 or 60 is 0.156^4 = 5.9e-4 (0.06%, under the 0.1% per pair limit). Contrast arm of the weapon-plus-attack-power structure: +20000 attack power (player_attack_power): attack power 20312, 2 x (73.62 + 4787.79 + 50) to 2 x (103.34 + 4787.79 + 50) = 9822.8 to 9882.3. Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history spell 563268: 0 events in 186 logs; spell 803476 (the off-hand hit of Felrend): 1580 SPELL_DAMAGE events by players in 5 logs (min 25, max 492, mean 141, 249 crits), gear, attack power and weapons of the loggers unknown, so no figure decides; nothing else found beyond the tooltip and Spell.dbc. Ten hits per read: the dummy and 9 area dummies at 2 to 5.5 yd stand inside the 6 yd area of Felrend (EffectRadiusIndex 193), one cast hits all ten, each target gets its own weapon roll, and the read sums every critical hit of 563268. Ten targets, not twelve: an exploratory run with twelve enemies struck all twelve (12 critical hits) but summed to 10 hits' worth of damage in both arms (4222 and 98530), so an AoE reduction of 10 / targets applies above ten targets and ten targets avoid it. Per hit the expected critical is 2 x (mean of the integer rolls + 50): the Tyrant roll ints (min and max truncated, Unit.cpp:3626) at attack power 312 are 147 to 176 (mean 161.5, hit 423) and at 20312 are 4861 to 4890 (mean 4875.5, hit 9851), so the sums are 10 x 423 = 4230 and 10 x 9851 = 98510. The window is +-145 on the sum (+-14.5 per hit). A flat of 40 or 60 moves each hit by 20 (sum 200). The standard deviation of the sum of 10 critical hits is 2 x 8.6 x sqrt(10) = 54.4 (roll uniform over 29.7 points, doubled by the critical). One read accepts a flat of 40 or 60 only if the sum falls 55 or more toward the window from the wrong mean: z = (200 - 145) / 54.4 = 1.01, probability 0.156 per read. The pair holds 4 independent reads (2 runs x 2 attack power arms), so the residual failure probability of accepting a flat of 40 or 60 is 0.156^4 = 5.9e-4 (0.06%, under the 0.1% per pair limit). A true flat of 50 fails one read with probability 0.8% (z = 2.67). The earlier single-hit read was bounded only against 0 and 100.

Band 5% of the expected value: the halving is an engine rule applied to the weapon roll, the flat and the attack power term together, and a tighter band would claim a rounding order the code does not state; 5% still excludes the unhalved strike (about 13165), the weapon part alone halved (about 9700) and a missing attack power term; the flat itself is proved by the hit_off entry at the reference attack power.

apply_stamp.source: 805748 DurationIndex 27 = 3000 ms (SpellDuration.dbc); the aura is still on the dummy; a bracket between 2710 and 2990 ms after the apply proves it outlives 2700 ms (excludes a duration 10% short) and stays below 3000 ms

behaviours.observe_source: Ruin 501298 Inner Demon: AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp:375 applies the DoT 805748 (Effect[0] aura 3 PERIODIC_DAMAGE, amplitude 1000 ms, DurationIndex 27 = 3000 ms, $805748d) on the Ruin hit. One real Ruin cast (CastingTimeIndex 19 = 2500 ms, then the missile; the DoT lands about 2870 ms after the cast command, inner_dot_share) at the dummy with Inner Demon 804216 held as a precondition fixture (Felfury x6 and At Least 2 Felfury 803468 precondition fixtures, 823764 no partial resists, Blessed Resilience 33143 on the dummy so no hit crits). An encounter timeline opened in the after phase (apply_stamp after the trigger, ADR 1284) stamps the one apply of 805748 on the dummy after the completed cast. Its stamps are offsets from the boss engage time (CoAGameplayTimeline.cpp:104), so the apply is placed in game time through an anchor: Blessed Resilience 33143 (aura 197, -1001 attacker crit chance), already a dummy precondition fixture unrelated to 805748, is removed and set again right after the opening, between two game-time reads, and its apply stamp is compared with the DoT's; the re-set leaves the fixture in place before the cast, so the claim is unchanged. The reading's age is bracketed from the DoT apply itself. The aura is read on the dummy about 5700 ms after the cast command (about 2830 ms after the apply): present (1); 0 in the control phase that casts nothing. Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history spell 805748 holds 1737 SPELL_AURA_APPLIED and 1737 SPELL_AURA_REMOVED events in 12 logs; in fight 1318 (log 94, 2026-08-09) the apply-to-remove intervals are 2.9 s x14, 3.0 s x6 and 3.1 s x1, consistent with 3000 ms (fw-rbk5 review M-2).

behaviours.name: Carve (parry while channeling)
behaviours.quote: @ext:Can dodge and parry while channeling and you can channel while moving.:ext@
behaviours.observe_source: Carve 800206 Description (@ext): 'Can dodge and parry while channeling and you can channel while moving.' The engine zeroes a melee strike's parry while the victim casts or channels (Unit::MeleeSpellHitResult, Unit.cpp:3920-3923) unless Unit::CanDefendDuringChannel allows it (Unit.cpp:5120-5133, a Demon Hunter channelling 800206). A player parries only when Player::CanParry is set (Unit::GetUnitParryChance, Unit.cpp:4321-4335), which a parry-percent aura sets (AuraEffect::HandleAuraModParryPercent, SpellAuraEffects.cpp:4870-4881): Parry Dance 560651 (Effect[0] aura 47 SPELL_AURA_MOD_PARRY_PERCENT) is set on the caster by harness set_aura in both arms as a named precondition, because the earlier attempt landed every strike with parry 100% for a caster that cannot parry. A passive striker (creature 36) casts Speed Slash 2118233 (melee) at the caster three times 800 ms into the channel, 200 ms apart, with the caster's parry set to 100% and dodge 0 right before (harness set_combat_avoidance, a named precondition fixture); the damage events of 2118233 on the caster are counted. Carve: every strike is parried, 0 events. Control: the _control entry with Sargeras Embrace 800355 (no exemption) reads 3 landed strikes under the same fixtures. Felfury x6 and 803468 are set on the caster for Carve (precondition fixtures, as the consumes entry). Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history spell 800206 Carve: 200 casts in 5 logs, no avoidance figure; nothing else found beyond the tooltip, Spell.dbc and the engine code.
