behaviours.name: Pure Hatred (Hateforged Barrier maximum health term direction)
behaviours.quote: Your Hateforged Barrier now also scales with your maximum health.
behaviours.power_aura_source: Infernal Constitution 805256: Effect[0] aura 133 SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_HEALTH_PERCENT, EffectBasePoints[0] 9 (+10% maximum health); Effect[1] aura 122 (off-hand damage) does not reach the barrier
behaviours.observe_source: The server adds 10% of maximum health to effect 0 of the Hateforged Barrier chain (705129 ranks, here rank 6 707527 of spell_ranks) while 803478 is known (AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp:535-536), a value with no tooltip source, not judged. Sample (controller choice (c), mentor D-94): one strike of Ray of Pain 54416 (Effect[0] 2 school damage, EffectBasePoints 1999 = 2000 Shadow, no die, no per-level term) by a passive striker after each barrier; the absorbed amount of that strike (spell_absorb_total, an event read) is one sample when the barrier was up after the cast, gone after the strike and the strike logged once. Margin: the largest learned barrier is 707527 EffectBasePoints 751 + 32 + 2.45 x 60 (per level, an upper bound) + Stamina 79 (reference_stats) + 10% of the maximum health with 805256, (3440 level-60 BaseHP of class 14, rev_20261105_95, + 610 Stamina health) x 1.1 = 4455, so at most about 1455 < 2000 (margin at least 545); the remaining read voids any barrier the strike did not break. Exploratory run 2026-11-24 (fw-bptd, not counted): maximum health 2173 / 2390 without / with 805256, mean learned barrier 1088 at most, so the strike margin is about 900. Partial resists of the Shadow strike (50% or 75% of Ray of Pain 54416, about 1000 or 500) can leave a learned barrier (1048-1101 in the counted pair) standing: the remaining read voids those samples (3 or fewer per arm in the counted pair, 37-40 kept), so they are expected voids, not a fault; a control barrier (831-862) is below 1000 and still breaks. Sizing: the term is about 10% of the 217 maximum health gained (about 22) against a 1..32 die (sd about 9.2), so 40 casts per arm put the expected interaction z near 7.3 against the 3.2 quantile (the 15-cast exploratory run read 4.81). Full Heal 17683 (Effect 67, self) refills the caster before each cast; set_aura 0 only clears the previous barrier (D-94 condition 2). The sample proves the direction of the term only (a larger maximum health gives a larger barrier); that the barrier absorbs damage stays proven by the D-81 entry (taken_total_ratio 707527) (D-94 condition 3). Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history 803478 0 events in 186 logs (passive), 707527 SPELL_CAST_SUCCESS 303 / SPELL_AURA_REFRESH 652 events in 7 logs, no amounts.

behaviours.name: Felforged (earned: 3 reduced Fel Fireballs, the 4th full)
behaviours.quote: Your next 3 Fel Fireballs have a $s1% reduced cast time
behaviours.observe_source: Tooltip 806104 (embedded in 300490 by @s:806104:0@): 'Your next 3 Fel Fireballs have a $s1% reduced cast time for $d.' Expected from the tooltip and Spell.dbc: 806104 Effect[0] aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), BasePoints -31 + 1 (DieSides 1) = -30, so $s1 = 30 and the cut Fel Fireball 801312 (CastingTimes.dbc 16, 1500 ms) takes 1050 ms; the 3 charges come from the tooltip (806104 ProcCharges 0; the server counts them in AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp UseSelected, FelforgedCharges 3). The aura is earned for real (mentor D-67, no set_aura): Bane of Chaos 704368 (periodic damage every 3000 ms) is cast at the dummy every 3200 ms until 806104 is on the caster; 300490 rolls Chance() on its raw ProcChance 15 only while the caster holds 300490 (AscensionFelsworn.cpp:233), so 300490 is unlearned at the stop: no later tick grants 806104 again or resets its used-charge count (AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp:206-209). 806104 must still be on after the unlearn, with amount -30. Each Fel Fireball is cast with ignore_gcd and bracketed by game_time stamps and spell_cast_count polls; casts 1-3 must lie in 1005-1095 ms (30% cut, 10% of the figure), cast 4 in 1350-1650 ms (no cut), the game time is read when the feed stops and cast 4 must start before 0.9 of the 8000 ms aura (DurationIndex 31) has passed since that stamp, else the trial is void (review fw-rbaf I-1: the slots drift, cast 4 started 5901 ms after cast 1 in the prove1 pair, planned 5400), so a full cast 4 is not the natural expiry. A control Fel Fireball without the talent or the aura opens every trial and must lie in the full band. Reference search 2026-11-24 (fw-fa4, fw-baf): coa-history spell 300490/806104 and ~/CoaServer/reference: nothing beyond the tooltip and Spell.dbc.

behaviours.name: Hellfire Carver (a full Carve channel: each further Fel Fireball target struck takes less damage, 9 targets)
behaviours.quote: dealing less damage with each target struck.
behaviours.observe_source: Hellfire Carver 707444 Description (server DBC set): 'Casting Carve now makes your next Fel Fireball instant cast and causes it to strike 1 additional enemy near the primary target based on how long you channeled, up to a maximum of 10 enemies, dealing less damage with each target struck.' The tooltip states a direction only (no figure). A real full Carve 800206 (setup cast, channel ended after 3000 ms) precedes one real Fel Fireball 801312 at the primary dummy (3 yd); eight more dummies stand at 3.2 to 4.6 yd from the caster, so 9 targets, all inside the cap (mentor D-100 (4): 9 targets judged strictly). The plain judge sums the hits (before, Hellfire Carver not learned: 1, the primary; after: 1 + 9). target_order (mentor D-101) repeats the treatment 16 times and reads per cast each target's 801312 damage without critical, resisted or blocked hits and every position: the targets are ranked by their measured distance from the primary (the order key; it is chosen because the server picks the extra targets nearest the primary first, AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp:148-160 with the sort by distance in AscensionFelsworn.cpp:174-186, and scales the damage by target rank, AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp:228-238), and the mean damage per rank must fall strictly over the 9 ranks. A cast with two distances within 0.01 yd is void. Sizing: Fel Fireball rolls die 5 (EffectDieSides 5) on a hit of about 24 at the primary, so one cast can invert two adjacent ranks (read 23 then 24 in one cast); the judge takes the mean of 16 casts: a bootstrap of the per-rank reads of two runs (12 casts) gives a non-falling mean with probability 1e-5 per run at 12 casts (2.2e-3 with 8 casts), a conservative bound for the 16 casts used, and a rank is unmeasured only when the target took a critical, resisted or blocked hit in all 16 casts (1 such hit in 124 reads of two runs). The server factor max(0.2, 1 - 0.1 x rank) reaches 0.2 at the 9th target, so its floor binds only from the 10th target struck, outside the 9 judged targets; owner ruling Felsworn O-37 (2026-11-24, question N-12, Felsworn ADR 0031) keeps the floor: targets 9 to 11 are conformant by the ruling. Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history spell 803715 (Carve end slash): 1086 SPELL_DAMAGE events by players in 5 logs (188 crits, 37 to 1630), no channel length or target rank in the log lines; spell 801312: 0 events (live Fel Fireball logs under 501286-501288 carry no Hellfire Carver marker); bindmysoul snapshot and earlier searches (fw-ea5) found nothing beyond the tooltips.

behaviours.name: Carve (end slash: each further target struck takes less damage, 9 targets)

behaviours.observe_source: Carve 800206 Description (server DBC set): 'Upon ending the channel, slash in front of you, dealing increased Weapon Damage with both weapons based on how long you channel, dealing less damage with each target struck.' Direction only (no figure). One real Carve at the dummy (3 yd) with eight more dummies at 3.5 to 7.0 yd in front of the caster; the channel runs out (3000 ms wait against DurationIndex 66, 2500 ms). The plain judge counts the end slash 803715 on the 9 targets, both weapons each (before: no cast, 0; after: 18). target_order (mentor D-101) repeats the full channel 8 times and reads per cast each target's 803715 damage without critical, resisted or blocked hits (both hands) and every position: targets are ranked by measured distance from the caster (the order key; chosen because the server strikes the enemies in front nearest first, AscensionFelswornAuras.cpp:228-246), and the mean per rank must fall strictly over the 9 ranks. Sizing: the weapon roll makes one cast too noisy for adjacent ranks (the first run read 681 at rank 1 and 689 at rank 2 in one cast), hence the mean of 8 casts: a uniform model over the observed per-target spread gives no non-falling mean in 200,000 trials of 8 casts (1.6e-4 with 4); no critical hit in 144 reads of the first run. The 0.2 floor of the server factor (max(0.2, 1 - 0.1 x rank), AscensionFelswornAuras.cpp:237) binds only from the 10th target struck, outside the 9 judged targets; Carve has no target cap (the loop stops at 25, AscensionFelswornAuras.cpp:248), so the slash stays at the floor from the 10th enemy; owner ruling Felsworn O-37 (2026-11-24, question N-12, Felsworn ADR 0031) keeps the floor. behaviours.observe_source: 805243 Infernal Whipcrack (server DBC): 'Enrage $?s800220[all][up to $i] allies within $a yds', MaxAffectedTargets 8 ($i), Effects[0-1] TargetB 56 TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID radius index 9 (20 yd), Effect[2] the same target with radius index 18 (15 yd, SpellRadius.dbc), AttributesEx3 SPELL_ATTR3_ONLY_ON_PLAYER, so the allies are players: the caster and nine grouped players (a raid of ten, scenario schema 2), every ally 34.6 yd from the caster. Infernal Whipcrack is cast for real in both phases (cooldown reset before each cast; 10600 ms between phases let the 10000 ms aura expire); 800220 is learned between them. 800220 (server DBC): Effect[1] SPELLMOD_RADIUS +15 with class mask (32,0,0) = 805243's SpellFamilyFlags, applied to every effect of 805243 (SpellEffectInfo::CalcRadius, SpellInfo.cpp:624-639; no effect index in the mod match): Effects[0-1] 35 yd and Effect[2] 30 yd. The engine selects Effect[2] apart (its radius differs, Spell.cpp:997-1004) with its own cap. The distance is chosen so that only the script can enrage all ten: before the learn the allies stand beyond Effects[0-1]'s 24.16 yd edge (caster alone, 1); after it, beyond Effect[2]'s widened 34.16 yd edge (it still reaches the caster alone) and inside Effects[0-1]'s 39.16 yd edge, where the cap keeps 8 of the ten, so a server without AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp:162-167 reads 8 or 9 (review fw-rbk3 I-1: at 20 yd the widened Effect[2] reached the allies and two independent cap-8 picks made 10 in about 0.62 of runs). The script adds every friendly unit found by Nearby(player, Effects[0] radius 35) (a cell visit of +- 35 yd, then 38 yd with both object sizes) with all three effects: 10. No random path gives 10 without the script (code reading; no server mutant run). The cap is not this entry's subject: the before reading is 1 here. Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history spell 805243: 0 events in 186 logs; expected values come from the tooltip and the DBC only.

behaviours.observe_source: 805243 Infernal Whipcrack (server DBC): 'Enrage $?s800220[all][up to $i] allies within $a yds', Effects[0-1] TargetB 56 TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID radius index 9 (20 yd, $a), Effect[2] radius index 18 (15 yd), MaxAffectedTargets 8. The caster and two grouped players: ally 23.7 yd and ally2 25.5 yd from the caster along x. Infernal Whipcrack is cast for real in both phases (cooldown reset before each cast; 10600 ms between phases let the 10000 ms aura expire); 800220 is learned between them (it widens every radius by 15 yd and adds the script's 'all' targets, AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp:162-167). The radius read is the before phase: Effects[0-1] (radius index 9, $a = 20 yd) reach 20 + 2.66 (party area leeway, Spell.cpp:1396-1401, Object.cpp:1787-1808) + 1.5 (the ally's object size, IsWithinDist3d, Spell.cpp:9465, Object.cpp:1355-1358) = 24.16 yd (21.5 yd without the leeway); Effect[2] (index 18, 15 yd) reaches 19.16 yd (16.5 yd), so the ally at 23.7 yd holds the aura through Effects[0-1] alone and the ally at 25.5 yd does not; the two arms bracket the edge (a radius 10% low, 18 yd, edge 22.16 yd, misses the ally at 23.7 yd; one 10% high, 22 yd, edge 26.16 yd, reaches the ally at 25.5 yd); the 2.66 yd leeway is read from code only (Spell.cpp:1396-1401, Object.cpp:1787-1808; no stock area control, accepted under G-29 and ADR 0253), and the ally at 23.7 yd is inside the edge only with it, the ally at 25.5 yd outside with or without it; three candidates stay below the cap 8, so the pick is not random. The after phase reads both allies enraged. The caster holds the aura in both phases (main reading 1 and 1). The target cap $i is not read here (a deterministic cap read needs a per-effect aura holder read, a tool idea). behaviours.name: Betrayer (off-hand Weapon Damage of the strike back)
behaviours.quote: Dodging attacks causes $804336s2% off-hand Weapon Damage to attackers
behaviours.observe_source: Betrayer strike 804336 (server DBC set): Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG (121), EffectBasePoints 0 + 1 die side = 1 flat, no points per level; Effect[1] SPELL_EFFECT_WEAPON_PERCENT_DAMAGE (31), EffectBasePoints 39 + 1 = 40% ($804336s2); DmgClass 2 melee, Physical (SchoolMask 1), no school damage effect, AttributesEx3 0. Engine sequence (SpellEffects.cpp:4665-4747): the flat part times the hand's TOTAL_PCT is added to the normalized weapon roll at effect 0, then the 40% is applied at effect 1 (ApplyPct, truncated), then the melee bonuses and armor. The tooltip states the hand: 'off-hand Weapon Damage', so the expectation reads the off-hand weapon of the entry's set with the off-hand factor 0.5 (UNIT_MOD_DAMAGE_OFFHAND TOTAL_PCT, Unit.cpp:519) on the roll and on the flat part (int(1 x 0.5) = 0): 40% x 0.5 x (roll + AP/14 x the normalized speed). The server DBC has no SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_OFF_HAND_WEAPON on 804336 (pair fw-bk3 read the main hand, about twice the expectation); since owner ruling Felsworn O-40 (2026-11-24, Felsworn ADR 0032) AscensionFelsworn::ApplyContracts adds it (Felsworn ADR 0032), so Spell.cpp:600 sets OFF_ATTACK for every cast, the direct one included. The strike is cast directly at the dummy (control_casts []: the control arm casts nothing and must count 0 hits), the hit_spell precedent of Vengeful Intent 705534. spell_weapon_sets maps 804336 to the Tyrant set of 300476 (item 2529 in both hands), so the judge arms the same set as the generated scenario: the judge arms the hit spell's set, the scenario the entry spell's. Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history spell 804336: 3 damage events in 2 logs (14 to 74), too few and with unknown gear to decide a value.

behaviours.name: Unphased (spell penetration, level 60)
behaviours.quote: Increases your spell penetration by ${-($m1+0)}, scaling with your level.

shifted_control.source: the shift is -(803645 Effect[0]) at the caster level; equality within 5% of the control span separates a penetration 10% off the shift (54 or 66 at level 60) under a resist chance linear in resistance, and at least half the span below the control excludes no penetration and any penetration of half the shift or less

behaviours.observe_source: Unphased 803645 Effect[0] aura 123 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE, MiscValue 124 (Fire, Nature, Frost, Shadow, Arcane), EffectBasePoints -21, EffectDieSides 1, EffectRealPointsPerLevel -1.0, BaseLevel 20, SpellLevel 20, MaxLevel 0 (server DBC). SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue (SpellInfo.cpp:479-506): -21 + (L - 20) x -1 + 1 = -L, so -60 at level 60 and -40 at level 40; the tool derives it from these fields and refuses a stated shift that differs. Unit::GetEffectiveResistChance (Unit.cpp:2589-2603) adds the caster's MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE total to the victim's resistance before the floor at 0, so a learned 803645 must read the resist chance of a resistance lowered by L. Fixture: Shadow Protection 976 (Effect[0] aura 143 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE_EXCLUSIVE, MiscValue 32 Shadow) on the dummy at 150 by set_aura amount, read in every arm (150, 150 - L, 150). Bless 804247 is the harmless self cast in both phases. Evidence: spell_resist_chance is a readback (the in-process GetEffectiveResistChance probe, no hit, CoAGameplayTest.cpp:5176-5181), behaviour only in the learned contrast with the penetration words (Felsworn D-110 (2026-11-24)): it proves the caster's penetration as the engine applies it to the resist chance, not observed resists. Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history spell 803645: a passive leaves no event; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC.
